summary: Stay of discharge order in serious criminal case; revisional jurisdiction under CrPC Ss.397, 401; High Court power to suspend discharge and order custody; reference to S.390 CrPC for appeal against acquittal; status of accused revives upon admission of revision; discharge order stayed; custody justified pending revision; powers under BNSS noted.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.302, s.201, s.34, s.120B
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; High Court's stay of discharge and direction to surrender upheld; liberty to apply for bail maintained; discharge not set aside but operation suspended pending revision.
